messages:
rachel: Heads-up — nightly perf alerts flagged a Mixtral-MoE 8x regression on staging :eyes:. p50 ~+6%, p95 ~+12% vs yesterday. Router logits distribution looks skewed; a couple of experts hot-saturated. attaching quick profile dump below.

samir: ugh. any single-change suspects? kernel selection, batching, or KV eviction pressure?

rachel: prelim profile points at two things: (1) router_topk still 1 for most traffic, causing repeated expert contention; (2) kernel fallback happening for padded batch sizes -> more small-kernel launches.

miguel: can you paste the profiler snippet?

rachel: sure — relevant lines:
```
model: mixtral-8x-moe
batches: mean=12, p95=46
router: avg_temp=0.21, topk=1, skewness=3.7
expert_invoke: avg_experts_per_request=1.05, hot_expert_99=0.42
kernel_select: fastpath_hits=71%, fallback_launches=29%
kv_cache: hit_rate=0.88, eviction_rate=0.06
latency: p50=48ms, p95=189ms (baseline p95=168ms)
```

elaine: interesting that kv hit_rate is OK. so eviction not the main culprit. fallback_launches and router skew look bad.

yusuf: router temp 0.21 is pretty low -> routing is peaky. Can we try topk=2 and increase routing jitter? small A/B?

perf-bot: nightly-bench results available: https://perf.internal/runs/176999/summary (automated diff: p95 +11.9%)

samir: propose quick canary config: topk:2, router_temp:0.32, expert_parallelism:increase from 1->2 for hot experts, and kernel batchpad threshold tunable to prefer vectorized kernel for sizes >= 16.

miguel: agree. also try selective expert caching tweak: increase expert_cache_capacity from 64->128 to reduce remote recompute for heavy experts. that should lower RPC overhead if any.

rachel: creating canary with these knobs now. config snippet: 
```json
{
  "router": {"topk": 2, "temperature": 0.32, "jitter_ms": 2},
  "expert": {"parallelism": 2, "cache_capacity": 128},
  "runtime": {"kernel_batchpad_threshold": 16}
}
```

elaine: nice. also add runtime.trace=true for first 10k requests so we can see kernel selection timelines.

rachel: added trace flag. canary deploy started (canary id: canary-1769993571-a). will monitor p50/p95 and expert load balance.

perf-bot: canary health: 10m in — p95 down to +4% vs baseline. expert hotness 99th decreased from 0.42->0.21. kernel fallback down to 12%.

yusuf: promising. how about RoPE scaling interplay? any change to kv dims or heads?

samir: we didn't touch RoPE dims for this canary. earlier experiments showed mild p95 impact when RoPE scale mismatched head dim (rare), but this regression pattern aligns more with router/parallelism. keep RoPE experiments for a separate run.

miguel: TL;DR: immediate mitigation = topk=2 + small temp bump + expert parallelism + higher cache cap + kernel batchpad. Follow-up: run RoPE/head-dim ablations and a deeper kernel selection trace to rule out microkernel regressions.

rachel: I'll let canary run for 1h and then promote if stable. cc @eng-sre for capacity ops in case expert_parallelism increases infra needs. :thumbsup:

elaine: GH issue created: #3582 "mixtral: canary - expert saturation & kernel fallback mitigation" with links to profile and canary.

miguel: good. when promoting, remember to also update autoscaler policy to allow short-lived capacity spikes for experts to avoid throttles.

rachel: thanks team — will post final numbers once canary completes.

perf-bot: note: regression alert muted for this cluster after canary shows p95 delta <5% for 30m. :white_check_mark:
